account: The node objective is a single, bounded extraction task from a specific source file whose full content is present in the workspace_documents. The acceptance condition is mechanical: locate at least one direct quote or close paraphrase stating MAD does not reliably outperform other prompting strategies (e.g., self-consistency, ensembling) and record the exact PDF page marker(s). The source text is grounded and available for immediate extraction, and no sibling future output is needed. Thus, solve is appropriate.

decidability.account: The dossier contains the full content of the Smit file with page markers (PDF PAGE 1 through PDF PAGE 23). The acceptance condition is a straightforward check for a quote/paraphrase and page marker. There is no dependency on other children, and all required evidence is present in the workspace document.
